change_summary: Add efficiency guidelines instructing the agent to disambiguate the target order from the user's description before fetching details, avoiding per-order/per-product lookups.
reason_for_change: Transcripts show the agent pulls get_order_details for every order (41 calls; tasks 103/99/69 fetch 3-5 orders serially) and unnecessary get_product_details, adding tool round-trips and tokens. Instructing it to narrow to the order matching the user's stated items (or ask a quick clarifying question) cuts redundant tool calls while preserving all information needed for success, lowering mean cost per task.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.5833 < floor 0.6333
hypothesis: The agent fetches get_order_details for every order individually (41 calls total; tasks 103/99/69 pull 3-5 orders serially) even when only one is relevant; instructing the agent to disambiguate the target order from the user's description before fetching details reduces redundant tool calls.
